title: ExplorerUsageLink
responsibility: Opens a consumer entity and previews its own revision-bound screenshot on hover or keyboard focus.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink.entity
inputs.description: Referenced entity at the shown revision; its own capture is used.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink.nav
inputs.description: Navigation preserving the selected branch and commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink.lens
inputs.description: The selected revision evidence resolver; no screenshot is borrowed from another entity.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink.mediaBase
inputs.description: URL prefix resolving the referenced screenshot file.

outputs.name: ExplorerUsageLink
outputs.description: A normal entity link with a viewport-bounded hover/focus preview, screenshot provenance and explicit missing-image fallback. Escape dismisses the preview; touch and Enter navigate.
